concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 1 – Data ingestion, cleaning, and provenance:T003
concerns.text: T003 asks the implementer to download the experimental CCR dataset from a “real URL to be supplied by the reviewer”. The URL is not specified anywhere in the repository, making the task unexecutable as written because the implementer has no concrete source to fetch. Provide a concrete, verified dataset URL (or a placeholder path) in the spec or tasks so the ingestion script can be implemented and tested.
